## About
Wolfgang opened his own repair shop, and it has long been at this spot on Parkside Drive in Walnut Creek. When the time came for him to retire, Fred took over and decided to keep Wolfgang's going.
We focus on BMW, Mini Cooper and Mercedes. Our reputation has been built by loyal customers over the years, and more recently through places like Yelp and Facebook. Today the shop holds a 5 star rating from 57 Google reviews.

## Services
- BMW, Mini Cooper and Mercedes: These are the makes we focus on and know best.
- Brakes and struts: A reviewer came in needing new brakes and struts and called the work fantastic.
- Engine coolant leaks: A reviewer had an engine coolant leak taken care of by the team.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in BMW, Mini Cooper and Mercedes.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Call us at (925) 947-6848 or email WolfgangsWC@gmail.com.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on weekends.

It is a stressful time having a breakdown especially with my family, but this shop really went above and beyond. I will be always grateful. This would be my go to shop if I lived in the area for my BMWs, I could instantly tell they knew what they were doing and were enthusiastic about older BMWs. I think the owner’s name is Fred and I really wanted to thank him! Kindhearted folks like this are hard to find nowadays." (Robin M, 5/5)
